SRI LANKA INSTITUTE OF ARCHITECTS
Regulations of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects

REGULATIONS made under Section 6(1) of Section 6(2) read with Sections 3, 4, 7 and 9 of the Sri Lanka Institute ofArchitects Law No. 1 of 1976 as amended by Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 1996.
Archt. ROHANA BANDARA HERATH,Honorary Secretary.
Sri Lanka Institute of Architects,No. 120/7, Vidya Mawatha,Colombo 7,05th January 2018.
1. Regulation 1.2 of the regulations published in Extraordinary Gazette No. 2041/18 of October 17, 2017 ishereby repealed and replaced with the following new regulation :
Regulation 1.2

The “Practice of Architecutre” is the rendering of professional services relating to the holistic planning anddesigning of the built environment in terms of form, space and ambience to reflect functional, technical, social,

This includes but is not limited to the design of the interior, exterior, the landscape,the externals, the layouts, their manipulation in terms of scale, texture, colour, light and shade and includesrestoration, refurbishment, retrofitting and conservation of individual buildings or groups of buildingsincorporating natural elements or landscapes. The practice of Architecture also encompasses aspects of realizingbuildings and structures, management, administration of projects and inspection of construction anddocumentation which includes drawings and specifications and other technical inputs.
The practice of Architecture shall be carried out solely by persons and entities qualified in Architecture registeredwith the Architects Registration Board.
2. Insertion of new regulation 7.4.2 (2) (c) to the regulations published in Extraordinary Gazette No. 2041/18 ofOctober 17, 2017.
Regulation 7.4.2 (2) (c)

In the event of inability of the Immediate Past President to carry out the functions of the office as Immediate PastPresident due to ill health, death or being unavailable for a period exceeding six (6) months, a member of the Collegeof Past Presidents who does not hold a formal office at the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects shall be appointed bythe Council as the “Past President in Council” and shall hold office for the unexpired period of term of office of theImmediate Past President whom he succeeds.
